game.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
game.blurb: Turn-based role-playing game in the Koronus Expanse, from Owlcat Games, released 2023-12-06. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genres: Adventure, RPG, Strategy, Indie. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Prologue and Chapter 1
chapters.summary: The prologue, the first chapter and the fate of Janus, Kiava Gamma and Dargonus.

chapters.title: Chapters 2 and 3
chapters.summary: The middle of the story, including the Commorragh arena.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 and the Finale
chapters.summary: The last chapters and the end of the game. Hidden achievements sit here too. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Daring Difficulty and Convictions
chapters.summary: Finishing as each kind of Votary or Zealot, Grim Darkness mode, and feats that need Daring difficulty.

chapters.title: Companions and Choices
chapters.summary: Romance, secret companions, the Bloodspun Web, mysteries and choices along the way.

chapters.title: Combat and Archetypes
chapters.summary: Critical hits, dodges, big kills, tanks and second and third-tier archetypes.

chapters.title: Void Battles, Colonies and Exploration
chapters.summary: Void combat, colonies, contracts, warp routes, systems and optional locations.

chapters.title: The Museion, Sector Bionica and Zarkov
chapters.summary: Trazyn's Museion, the Sector Bionica and the Zarkov colony, which sit at the end of the Steam list.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2186680)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Warhammer_40,000:_Rogue_Trader
Fandom (warhammer40k.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://warhammer40k.fandom.com/wiki/Warhammer_40,000:_Rogue_Trader
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents subpages, but none of them exists, so nothing was used. warhammer40k.fandom.com answers the API with about 34 linked articles (lore pages such as "Koronus Expanse", "House von Valancius", "Theodora von Valancius" and "Calixis Sector"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 2186680 is the base game. 32 of 133 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the finale chapter as a placeholder, though many are probably side quests or companion events from any chapter. The Steam list names a Prologue and Chapters 1 to 4, so the story chapters follow them. About 20 achievements near the end of the Steam list (Trazyn and the Museion, the Sector Bionica, Zarkov, the Chronomancer, the soldiers of Krieg) have very low unlock rates (0.1 to 3%) and are grouped together; the data does not say they come from add-on content. "Preserve the Architecture" (a defiler fight, 2.9%) sits earlier in the list and is left with the choices chapter. Achievements that need Daring difficulty in those places are put with them rather than with the difficulty chapter. "Void Shadows" (dispelling the shadows in the void) sits with void battles.
